mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 enzymes, potentially increasing nortriptyline levels; additive anticoagulant effects may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for nortriptyline toxicity signs (anticholinergic effects, CNS depression, cardiac arrhythmias); consider INR monitoring if concurrent anticoagulation; dose adjustment may be necessary with high-dose turmeric supplementation.
